title: Adjacent Normal Skin Tissue Rep1 [71N]
extract_protocol_ch1: Skin biopsy tissues were snap frozen in liquid nitrogen and grinded using mortar and pestle. Total RNA extraction was performed using mirVana™ miRNA Isolation Kit (Thermo Fisher) following manufacturer’s protocol.
extract_protocol_ch1_2: RNA Sequencing libraries were prepared using Illumina Stranded Total RNA Prep with Ribo-Zero Plus Kit (Illumina) for Total RNA-Sequencing
data_processing: Illumina HiSeq 4000 software was used for basecalling to generate paired-end reads of 200bp
data_processing_2: Sequenced reads were trimmed for adaptor sequences using CutAdapt, quality trimmed at the 3′ ends, then mapped to the human genome (hg19/GRCh37) using STAR (v2.7.10a) with parameters --quantMode GeneCounts --chimSegmentMin 15 --chimJunctionOverhangMin 15 --outSAMtype BAM SortedByCoordinate --outSAMstrandField intronMotif --chimOutType Junctions SeparateSAMold
data_processing_3: Transcript assembly of aligned reads was performed using StringTie (v1.3.3b).
data_processing_4: The python script prepDE.py (http://ccb.jhu.edu/software/stringtie/dl/prepDE.py) was used to genearte raw read counts for all annotated genes in the human (hg19) genome.
data_processing_5: Differential expression analysis was carried out using edgeR
data_processing_7: Supplementary files format and content: Tab-delimited text files include raw read counts for all annotated genes for each sample.
contact_address: 203 BT Road, HGU, Indian Statistical Institute
